## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`): the **DCO** check
- [ ] Only Apache-2.0 folders are touched (packs, templates, connectors, importers), so no CLA is needed; or I will agree to the CLA when the **Archigov CLA** check asks (once)
- [ ] `npm test` passes and `npm run typecheck` is clean in `server/` (and in `web/` if touched)
- [ ] If an AI agent helped: its commits carry an `Assisted-by:` trailer, and I reviewed every change and signed off myself
- [ ] Documentation impact: what this creates, updates or deletes, or "none" and why (the maintainer adds CHANGELOG lines for Apache-folder contributions)

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/00xE8/archigov/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
